verdict.rationale: Heap's pricing lists CSV exports on one tier and data warehouse integration on a higher tier. Both are first-party ways to get data out in open or portable forms, and a user-deletion API supports cleanly leaving the service. However, the evidence is only plan-feature bullets, with no documentation of what can be exported, in what formats, or whether a full raw dataset export is possible. Missing for 10: documented complete export of all raw event and user data, explicit open-format specifications, export availability on all plans rather than gated tiers, and independent corroboration of a full data exit.
